locations.name: New Iberia
locations.description: New Iberia, the Queen City of the Teche, is the parish seat of Iberia Parish, Louisiana. Founded in 1779 by Spanish settlers along Bayou Teche, it is known for its historic Main Street district, Shadows-on-the-Teche, and its Cajun and Creole heritage.

locations.name: Cypremort Point State Park
locations.description: Cypremort Point State Park sits on Vermilion Bay and offers one of the few beaches in the region, along with fishing, boating, sailing, and cabins overlooking the Gulf.

locations.name: Lake Fausse Pointe State Park
locations.description: Lake Fausse Pointe State Park lies within the Atchafalaya Basin's cypress-tupelo swamp, offering canoe trails, boardwalks, cabins, and some of the best paddling and wildlife viewing in south Louisiana.
